# Google Ad Services
> Google Ad Services supports ad delivery, click tracking, conversion measurement, and related advertising infrastructure used across Google properties and partner sites.

This domain is primarily used for advertising and measurement endpoints rather than human-oriented product documentation. Relevant documentation for understanding its behavior is published across Google Ads, Google Marketing Platform, Search Ads 360, Ad Manager, and Google tag resources.

## Google Ads Help
- [About conversion tracking](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/1722022): Explains how Google Ads measures valuable customer actions after ad interactions.
- [Set up website conversion tracking](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/6095821): Guides implementation of website conversions using Google tag and event snippets.
- [About the Google tag](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/7548399): Describes the Google tag used for Ads measurement and remarketing.
- [About auto-tagging](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3095550): Explains automatic addition of GCLID parameters for click measurement.
- [About click trackers](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2375435): Describes click tracking URLs and how they work in Google Ads.
- [About enhanced conversions](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/9888656): Covers privacy-safe conversion measurement using hashed first-party customer data.
- [About remarketing](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2453998): Introduces remarketing audiences and related tagging requirements.
- [About consent mode](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/10000067): Explains how consent signals affect Google Ads measurement and modeling.

## Google Ads API
- [Google Ads API overview](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/start): Introduces the API for managing Google Ads accounts and reporting.
- [Conversion uploads](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/conversions/overview): Explains importing offline and enhanced conversions into Google Ads.
- [Click conversion uploads](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/conversions/upload-clicks): Shows how to upload conversions attributed to ad clicks.
- [Call conversion uploads](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/conversions/upload-calls): Describes uploading conversions from phone calls to Google Ads.
- [Enhanced conversions for leads](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/conversions/enhanced-conversions/leads-setup): Details API setup for enhanced conversions for leads.
- [Remarketing and audience segments](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/remarketing/overview): Covers audience and remarketing management through the API.
- [Tracking URL templates](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/ads/tracking-urls): Explains tracking templates, final URL suffixes, and custom parameters.
- [Response metadata and request IDs](https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/concepts/call-structure#response_headers): Documents request tracing and headers useful for debugging integrations.

## Google Tag and Tag Manager
- [Google tag platform guide](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform): Entry point for Google tag implementation and measurement resources.
- [Set up the Google tag](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/gtagjs): Documents installation and configuration of gtag.js.
- [Google tag API reference](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/gtagjs/reference): Reference for gtag commands, parameters, and event configuration.
- [Tag Manager developer guides](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/tag-manager): Guides for implementing and extending Google Tag Manager.
- [Consent mode overview](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/security/guides/consent): Explains consent mode behavior across Google measurement products.
- [Measure conversions](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/devguides/conversions): Shows how to configure conversion measurement with Google tags.
- [Enhanced conversions guide](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/devguides/conversions/enhanced-conversions): Describes enhanced conversions implementation with the Google tag.
- [Cross-domain measurement](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/devguides/cross-domain): Explains linker behavior and cross-domain attribution setup.

## Search Ads 360
- [Search Ads 360 help center](https://support.google.com/sa360): Main help center for Search Ads 360 campaign and measurement workflows.
- [About Floodlight conversion tracking](https://support.google.com/sa360/answer/6023705): Introduces Floodlight activities and conversion measurement in SA360.
- [About URL options and tracking templates](https://support.google.com/sa360/answer/9571793): Explains tracking templates and URL parameter handling in SA360.
- [About parallel tracking](https://support.google.com/sa360/answer/9571794): Describes parallel tracking behavior for supported search engines.
- [About auto-tagging in Search Ads 360](https://support.google.com/sa360/answer/9571783): Covers click identifiers and tagging for attribution in SA360.
- [Search Ads 360 API overview](https://developers.google.com/search-ads): Introduces the Search Ads 360 API and integration concepts.

## Campaign Manager 360 and Floodlight
- [Campaign Manager 360 help center](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager): Main help center for trafficking, tags, and measurement in CM360.
- [About Floodlight](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2823222): Explains Floodlight tags, activities, and conversion counting.
- [Create Floodlight activities](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2826131): Guides setup of Floodlight activity groups and activities.
- [About click trackers](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2834211): Describes click tracker tags and redirect-based click measurement.
- [About impression trackers](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/2826134): Explains impression tracking tags for non-served creatives.
- [Campaign Manager 360 API overview](https://developers.google.com/doubleclick-advertisers): Introduces the API for trafficking and reporting in CM360.

## Google Ad Manager
- [Google Ad Manager help center](https://support.google.com/admanager): Main help center for ad serving, delivery, and reporting.
- [Ad Manager API overview](https://developers.google.com/ad-manager/api): Introduces the Ad Manager API for inventory and delivery management.
- [Generate ad tags](https://support.google.com/admanager/answer/177207): Explains generation and use of Google Publisher Tags and ad tags.
- [About click tracking](https://support.google.com/admanager/answer/6081628): Describes click tracking behavior for creatives and third-party redirects.
- [About impression tracking](https://support.google.com/admanager/answer/6081627): Covers impression tracking with creatives and tracking pixels.
- [Google Publisher Tag overview](https://developers.google.com/publisher-tag): Entry point for GPT implementation documentation.
- [Secure signals and privacy](https://developers.google.com/publisher-tag/guides/privacy): Documents privacy-related GPT configuration and signal handling.

## Privacy and Policy
- [How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites): Explains data handling for sites using Google advertising and measurement services.
- [Advertising technologies](https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads): Describes Google advertising cookies, identifiers, and related technologies.
- [Privacy Sandbox](https://privacysandbox.com/): Overview of privacy-preserving advertising and measurement proposals on the web.
- [EU user consent policy](https://www.google.com/about/company/user-consent-policy/): Defines consent requirements for Google ads and measurement products in certain regions.
- [Google Ads policies](https://support.google.com/adspolicy): Central policy resource for Google Ads advertisers.
- [Data processing terms](https://business.safety.google/adsprocessorterms/): Provides contractual terms related to Google advertising data processing.

## Troubleshooting and Validation
- [Tag Assistant](https://tagassistant.google.com/): Google tool for validating tag installation and troubleshooting measurement issues.
- [Google Ads status dashboard](https://status.ads.google.com/): Service status information for Google Ads and related systems.
- [Google Marketing Platform status dashboard](https://status.marketingplatform.google.com/): Status information for Campaign Manager 360, SA360, and related products.
- [Conversion tracking troubleshooting](https://support.google.com/google-ads/topic/3165803): Help resources for diagnosing Google Ads conversion tracking issues.
- [Tag diagnostics in Google Ads](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/7645960): Explains diagnostics and common issues for conversion tags.
- [Debug Google tag implementations](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/devguides/debug): Guides debugging and validation of Google tag behavior.
